messages:
maya: Quick sync — choose one for the 3-day mini: (A) critical embed regression hitting paying customers, or (B) modal UX polish that improves onboarding CTR. Which do we take now?

sam: Regression, no contest. Customer tickets and SRE alert show high error rate on embed path.

lina: Agreed. Repro steps in staging take ~30m to trigger. I can own a quick spike to confirm root cause.

jon: If we pick regression, suggest scoped patch + dark-launch the UX change later. The modal polish can be A/B in 2 weeks.

anita: Data: modal polish = +2.8% for new users but 0.1% overall. Regression increases 500ms tail latency and causes failures for enterprise customers. Prioritize regression.

raj: Noted. Support backlog has 7 tickets linked to the embed bug. We risk churn if not fixed this week.

maya: Decision lean: regression-first. Can we ship a minimal fix in one deploy?

sam: Plan: 1) triage & reproduce (same day); 2) patch: defensive check + retry logic; 3) add unit + integration test; 4) canary (shore-1) + monitor for 6 hours. Expect ~2 dev days.

lina: I'll pair for integration test. Suggest we add a short e2e that simulates the embed payload edge-case.

jon: I'll draft customer-facing note for affected tenants. Keep it brief: "we're rolling a fix; expect improved embed reliability; contact support if you see anything."

anita: I'll create an alert baseline and add regression watch on embed_error_rate and embed_p99_latency. Also enable a dashboard card for the canary cohort.

maya: Can we leave the modal polish ticket in the sprint but tag as "deferred: wave-b" so it's visible for follow-up?

sam: Yes — I'll move the ticket and add acceptance criteria for the polish so it can be picked up later without re-scoping.

lina: One risk: test infra flakiness may add time. I'll reserve an extra half day in case of retries.

raj: Support comms: I'll post an update to customers in the affected list once canary looks good.

sam: Opening WIP PR now: branch hotfix/embed-robustness. Command to reproduce locally (dev note):

```
curl -X POST https://staging.api.redwood.ai/v1/embed -d '{"input":"<edge payload>"}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer $DEV_TOKEN'
```

I've added a failing test that mirrors the bug.

maya: Excellent. Who owns verification after canary?

anita: I'll own verification and will post status in #incidents if any rollback is needed.

jon: I'll queue the customer note draft; will wait for canary green.

deploy-bot: Canary deploy queued for commit d4f7a9b to cluster shore-1.

maya: Action items recap: Sam -> PR + patch; Lina -> integration tests + reserve extra time; Anita -> canary monitoring + dashboard; Jon -> customer note; Raj -> support comms; Maya -> update roadmap board and move modal polish to Wave B. Target: finish canary verification within 24h of deploy. Thank you :thumbsup:
